_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0/53 coil stat makes HOLD the only statistically defensible call — the August analog suggests a Denial bounce may be forming but no breaker has fired to justify a directional commitment.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — analyst explicitly calls HOLD citing its 0-for-18 directional track record and the coil; narrative implies a bullish reversal setup but does not issue a directional call, so they converge on 'don't act yet' for different reasons.
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear-Greed breaks above 30 with ETF flows turning positive and funding staying below 0.01%, signaling genuine Panic→Denial transition with institutional participation
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear-Greed drops below 24 with VIX spiking above 22 and DXY breaking 103, pushing deeper into Panic/Capitulation and killing the bottoming thesis
